key_features: Interactive Digital Aquarium: Interact with Bitzee like never before on a large display; Aquarium responds to touch – dip a finger in, tap, turn and press the dial, hatch eggs and feed with accessories
Nurture and Feed: These digital pets need love and care to grow from baby to adult; drop a pellet (5 included) and watch as the treat appears on the display, bringing play to life for kids 5 and up
Unlock 30 Aquatic Friends: Hatch, collect and evolve 30 Bitzee characters, including a sea snail, shark, seahorse, mermaid and more, for hours of engaging play; includes 3 AA batteries

Play, Earn, and Unlock: Pop bubbles and play 2 mini games to earn coins to spend in the Bitzee Shop; unlock 6 more games, customize your aquarium's lighting, and discover surprise eggs and treasure chests

Customizable Room Decor: Doubles as unique bedroom decor or desk decor with lights you can personalize to set the mood, bringing fun to any space; use the handle to take on-the-go, an exciting option for travel
Includes: 1 Bitzee Aquarium, 5 Pellets, 1 Quick Start Guide, 1 Instruction Sheet, 3 AA Batteries
